decisions.rationale: Lead Charizard/Venusaur preserves immediate Mega Charizard Y sun plus Chlorophyll pressure into the physical Grass/Steel-heavy possibilities. Kingambit is the strongest backline answer to Mega Gardevoir, while Raichu adds Fake Out, Encore, speed control via Nuzzle, and a Focus Sash safety net.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 opponent brought Sneasler, Weavile, Mega Venusaur, and Skarmory; Incineroar and Gardevoir were absent. Sneasler is Jolly Life Orb with Rock Slide and threatens Charizard. Weavile is Focus Sash with Ice Shard. Mega Venusaur has Thick Fat and is immune to Sleep Powder; its revealed attacks include Sludge Bomb and Earth Power. Charizard Y is a strong Mega option against that Game 1 four. Keep Kingambit as primary Mega Gardevoir contingency and Raichu as disruption support.

decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler+Venusaur-Mega: Sneasler Rock Slide is 4x on Charizard to break Drought/Chlorophyll, while Venusaur-Mega is Grass-immune to Sleep Powder and Thick Fat resists Heat Wave. Back Weavile for priority Ice Shard/Knock Off and Incineroar for Intimidate/FakeOut/Parting Shot pivot.
decisions.notebook: Opponent core: Charizard-Mega-Y (Timid Drought, HeatWave/AirSlash/SolarBeam/Protect), Chlorophyll Venusaur (WideLens SleepPowder/SludgeBomb/GigaDrain/Protect), Kingambit (Defiant/Chople/IronHead/Kowtow/SuckerPunch/Protect), Raichu (LightningRod/FocusSash/FakeOut/Nuzzle/Encore), Tauros-Aqua (Intimidate/Sitrus/WaveCrash/CloseCombat/RagingBull/Protect), Dragonite (Multiscale/Yache/Tailwind/AerialAce/IceSpinner/Protect). My team: Venusaur-Mega (ThickFat/Modest), Sneasler (LifeOrb/PoisonTouch/Jolly), Weavile (Pressure/FocusSash), Incineroar (Intimidate/Sitrus/Careful). Key: KO Charizard to kill Drought/Chlorophyll; Rock Slide 4x on Charizard, neutral on Venusaur. Venusaur-Mega Grass-immune to Sleep Powder, Thick Fat resists fire. Charizard outspeeds my Venusaur-Mega; Chlorophyll Venusaur in sun outspeeds everything. Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch, Raichu FakeOut/Encore, Tauros Intimidate. Plan: Sneasler Rock Slide Charizard, Venusaur-Mega absorbs sleep/resists fire; Weavile Ice Shard/Icicle Crash 2x on Charizard; Incineroar Intimidate/FakeOut/Parting Shot.

decisions.rationale: Mega Evolving immediately creates sun, activating Chlorophyll so Venusaur can put Sneasler to sleep before it can Rock Slide. Sun-boosted Heat Wave then pressures both foes, including substantial damage into a potential Mega Venusaur.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler outspeeds both foes; Rock Slide is 4x on Charizard (84-159%, not guaranteed OHKO). Doubling up with Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb secures the Charizard KO before it Mega-Evolves, preventing Drought/Chlorophyll sun. Mega Evolving Venusaur makes it Grass-immune to Sleep Powder and Thick Fat resists Heat Wave.

Defensive turn to stabilize while behind.

decisions.rationale: Air Slash is a guaranteed KO on Mega Venusaur from its shown HP. Chlorophyll Venusaur acts first; Wide Lens Sleep Powder gives the best chance to deny Incineroar’s sun-boosted, guaranteed Flare Blitz OHKO on Venusaur and preserve board control.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out flinches Charizard to stop its 2x Heat Wave/Air Slash from KOing my 44% Venusaur-Mega, while Earth Power (neutral) chips the sun-boosted Venusaur. Preserves Venusaur-Mega as pivot and buys time to bring Sneasler/Weavile for the Charizard KO that removes Drought/Chlorophyll.

Sneasler Rock Slide 4x on Charizard (84-159%) is my other Charizard answer once awake.

decisions.rationale: Charizard must Protect against Weavile’s priority Ice Shard at its current health. Chlorophyll Venusaur acts first in sun and Sleep Powder offers the best chance to neutralize Weavile, preserving Charizard for a decisive follow-up while Mega Venusaur cannot be slept.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Foe Venusaur (Chlorophyll 200-264) outspeeds Weavile and will Sleep Powder it, so Icicle Crash likely fails. Ice Shard (priority +1) is guaranteed to act first and hits Charizard (~29% KO at 21%). Venusaur-Mega Protects to survive Charizard's Air Slash if it survives; Protect is unreliable but the best defensive option. Sun ends next turn, slowing Venusaur.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Weavile Icicle Crash reliably KOs Charizard-Mega-Y (31-73%); Ice Shard only 15-35% (unreliable at 21%). Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb reliably KOs Charizard (29-63%) but Charizard outspeeds Venusaur-Mega (132-167 vs 100), so it can't be the finisher. Charizard Air Slash KOs Venusaur-Mega (52-88%); Heat Wave OHKOs Weavile (Focus Sash saves). Venusaur Sludge Bomb does NOT KO Venusaur-Mega (21-38%). Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb on Venusaur 31-70% (Venusaur at 65% may fall). Weavile Icicle Crash on Venusaur 61-137% (possible OHKO). Sun ends after this turn regardless (Drought already active). Plan: KO Charizard to remove Heat Wave/Air Slash threat; once sun ends Venusaur drops to 100-132 (slower than Weavile 194). Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch, Raichu FakeOut/Encore, Tauros Intimidate, Dragonite Tailwind. Sneasler (8% slp) Rock Slide 4x on Charizard is a backup answer once awake.

decisions.rationale: Air Slash guarantees the KO on Mega Venusaur if Charizard gets to move. Sleep Powder covers Weavile waking this turn: it may KO Charizard with Ice Shard first, but Venusaur can immediately put it back to sleep, preserving a favorable endgame.

Raichu preserves immediate Fake Out pressure on Mega Venusaur next turn, enabling Venusaur to attack it safely while Weavile remains asleep. Focus Sash also gives a disruption buffer; Kingambit is vulnerable to Mega Venusaur’s Earth Power.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s revealed game-2 four are Sneasler, Weavile, Mega Venusaur, and Incineroar. Sneasler is Jolly Life Orb and carries Close Combat, Rock Slide, Gunk Shot, Protect. Weavile is Jolly Focus Sash with Icicle Crash, Ice Shard, Knock Off, Protect. Mega Venusaur is Modest Thick Fat with Giga Drain, Sludge Bomb, Earth Power, Protect and is immune to Sleep Powder. Incineroar is Careful Sitrus Intimidate with Fake Out, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz, Darkest Lariat. Against Mega Venusaur, prioritize direct Poison/Flying pressure and Fake Out support rather than Sleep Powder. Preserve Raichu for Fake Out/Encore disruption and Kingambit for Fairy/Psychic matchups; avoid exposing Kingambit freely to Earth Power.

decisions.rationale: Double-target Charizard, the biggest threat. If Weavile wakes, Icicle Crash (guaranteed KO at 21%, Weavile 194 outspeeds Charizard 132-167) kills it before it can Air Slash Venusaur-Mega. Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb is a guaranteed backup KO if Weavile stays asleep but Venusaur-Mega survives. Removing Charizard eliminates Heat Wave/Air Slash pressure; Venusaur-Mega is Grass so immune to Sleep Powder.

Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch, Raichu FakeOut/Encore, Tauros Intimidate, Dragonite Tailwind. Sneasler (8% slp) Rock Slide 4x on Charizard is a backup once awake. Plan: prioritize removing Charizard; keep Venusaur-Mega alive as the awake attacker; Weavile outspeeds everything when awake.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out guarantees Weavile cannot wake and KO Venusaur this turn. Sludge Bomb is the only immediate meaningful pressure into Mega Venusaur and can finish it from its revealed damage range; Raichu can survive a likely Earth Power once via Focus Sash.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-2 four: Jolly Focus Sash Weavile (Icicle Crash, Ice Shard, Knock Off, Protect); Modest Thick Fat Mega Venusaur (Giga Drain, Sludge Bomb, Earth Power, Protect), immune to Sleep Powder; Jolly Life Orb Sneasler; Careful Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar. Weavile's Icicle Crash is a guaranteed KO on Venusaur from 66%, so deny its action whenever possible. Against Mega Venusaur, use direct Poison pressure plus Fake Out; preserve Raichu's Focus Sash and disruption tools when feasible. Kingambit must not be exposed freely to Earth Power.

decisions.rationale: Weavile is asleep; if it wakes it outspeeds everything and Icicle Crash KOs Venusaur (2x, 61-137%). Venusaur-Mega Protects: Raichu outspeeds it and Venusaur Sludge Bomb can KO it at 44% HP (up to ~47%), and Raichu Fake Out would flinch an attacking Venusaur-Mega. Protect blocks both, keeping my only awake attacker alive to support Weavile's cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Weavile Icicle Crash reliably KOs Charizard-Mega-Y (31-73%) and KOs Venusaur (61-137%, 2x). Ice Shard only 15-35% on Charizard. Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb reliably KOs Charizard (29-63%) but Charizard outspeeds it. Charizard Air Slash KOs Venusaur-Mega (52-88%); Heat Wave OHKOs Weavile (Focus Sash saves). Venusaur Sludge Bomb on Venusaur-Mega 21-47% (can KO at low HP); Venusaur-Mega Sludge Bomb on Venusaur 31-70%. Venusaur-Mega is Grass, immune to Sleep Powder. Sun ended; without sun Venusaur is 100-132, slower than Weavile 194. Raichu (143-178) outspeeds Venusaur-Mega (100) and has Fake Out + Focus Sash; Earth Power is 2x on it. Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch, Tauros Intimidate, Dragonite Tailwind. Sneasler (8% slp) Rock Slide 4x on Charizard once awake. Plan: keep Venusaur-Mega alive as awake attacker; Weavile outspeeds everything when awake and cleans up. Opponent back: Kingambit (Chople, Defiant), Tauros-Aqua (Intimidate, Sitrus), Dragonite (Multiscale, Yache, Tailwind).

decisions.rationale: Venusaur must Protect against Weavile’s guaranteed Icicle Crash KO. Thunderbolt is the strongest immediate chip into Weavile and keeps Raichu’s Focus Sash available to absorb a possible Knock Off or Earth Power, while beginning the two-target cleanup race.
decisions.notebook: Opponent game-2 four: Jolly Focus Sash Weavile (Icicle Crash, Ice Shard, Knock Off, Protect); Modest Thick Fat Mega Venusaur (Giga Drain, Sludge Bomb, Earth Power, Protect), immune to Sleep Powder; Jolly Life Orb Sneasler; Careful Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar. Weavile’s Icicle Crash guarantees a KO on Venusaur from 66%, so protect or otherwise deny it before Venusaur attacks. Raichu Thunderbolt does 30.5-56.6% to Weavile; Venusaur Sludge Bomb does 35.6-66.2% to Weavile and 27.3-47.1% to Mega Venusaur. Raichu is faster than Mega Venusaur but its order with Weavile is EV-dependent. Kingambit should not be freely exposed to Mega Venusaur Earth Power.

decisions.rationale: Weavile (194) acts first; Icicle Crash on foe Venusaur removes the Sleep Powder threat (61-137%, ~95% KO at 65% HP). Raichu is faster than Venusaur-Mega and always acts before it, so I can't stop its Nuzzle this turn; instead Giga Drain on Raichu breaks its Focus Sash (any damage does) while healing Venusaur-Mega from 44% to ~60-84%, setting up Raichu's KO next turn. Earth Power's extra damage is wasted by the sash, so the heal is strictly better.
decisions.notebook: Durable: Weavile Icicle Crash on Venusaur 61-137% (not guaranteed KO at 65% HP, 90% acc); Ice Shard too weak to KO. Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain on Raichu 34-80% (breaks sash + heals); Earth Power 2x 54-127% but sash wastes overkill. Raichu (143-178) always outspeeds Venusaur-Mega (100); Weavile (194) outspeeds all. Foe Venusaur faster than Venusaur-Mega. Foe back: Kingambit (Chople, Defiant), Tauros-Aqua (Intimidate, Sitrus), Dragonite (Multiscale, Yache, Tailwind). Venusaur-Mega is Grass, immune to Sleep Powder. Foe Venusaur Sludge Bomb on Venusaur-Mega 21-47% (KO risk at low HP). Plan: keep Venusaur-Mega healed via Giga Drain; Weavile cleans up once awake. Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch and Dragonite Tailwind.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Thunderbolt removes the weakened Weavile, preventing its continued Ice pressure. Venusaur must attempt Protect despite the reduced success chance; otherwise Ice Shard guarantees its KO before it can contribute. This preserves the best chance to reach a favorable two-versus-one against Mega Venusaur.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-2 four are Jolly Focus Sash Weavile, Modest Thick Fat Mega Venusaur, Jolly Life Orb Sneasler, and Careful Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar. Mega Venusaur is immune to Sleep Powder. Weavile’s Focus Sash is no longer intact. Weavile’s Icicle Crash/Ice Shard pressure forces Venusaur to Protect or remove/deny Weavile before acting. Raichu outspeeds Mega Venusaur but not necessarily Weavile. Avoid exposing Kingambit freely to Mega Venusaur Earth Power.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Weavile outspeeds all and Icicle Crash on Raichu is a guaranteed KO (min 41.9% vs 37% HP), removing the Nuzzle/Encore threat. Venusaur-Mega Earth Powers foe Venusaur (20.9-46.5%) to chip it toward KO range while staying safe from Sleep Powder (Grass immunity). Even if foe Venusaur Sleep Powders Weavile after it acts, Venusaur-Mega can finish Venusaur next turn.
decisions.notebook: Durable: Weavile Icicle Crash on Raichu min 41.9% (guaranteed KO at low HP); on Venusaur 61-136.8% (not guaranteed KO at 65%, 90% acc). Venusaur-Mega Earth Power on Venusaur 20.9-46.5% (neutral 1x). Venusaur-Mega Giga Drain on Raichu 34-80%; Earth Power on Raichu 2x 54-127%. Foe back: Kingambit (Chople, Defiant, SuckerPunch), Tauros-Aqua (Intimidate, Sitrus), Dragonite (Multiscale, Yache, Tailwind). Our back Incineroar/Sneasler were asleep. Plan: keep Venusaur-Mega healed via Giga Drain; Weavile cleans up. Watch Kingambit SuckerPunch and Dragonite Tailwind.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch is the only immediate chance to remove Weavile before it can pressure Venusaur; its 19.2–39.3% range can KO from 31%. Sludge Bomb covers a Sucker Punch miss/failure to KO if Weavile’s Icicle Crash misses, while also punishing a non-Protect line.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 opponent four confirmed: Jolly Focus Sash Pressure Weavile, Modest Thick Fat Mega Venusaur, Jolly Life Orb Poison Touch Sneasler, Careful Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar. Mega Venusaur is immune to Sleep Powder. Weavile’s Focus Sash has been broken. Kingambit Sucker Punch into Weavile is resisted but can KO at low HP; do not assume it is guaranteed. Protect chains on Venusaur can become unreliable. Preserve Kingambit from free Mega Venusaur Earth Powers where possible.

decisions.rationale: Weavile is fragile (32%) and both foes threaten it, so use it now to remove Venusaur (Ice 2x, 61-136.8%) while Venusaur-Mega chips Kingambit with Earth Power (42.5-93.7%). Venusaur-Mega is durable here (tanks Kingambit Iron Head 24-42%, foe Sludge Bomb 21-39%), immune to Sleep Powder, and can Giga Drain-heal, so even if Weavile falls to Sucker Punch/Iron Head, Venusaur-Mega can outlast and finish Kingambit with repeated Earth Power. Aggressive play maximizes progress toward the endgame win.
decisions.notebook: Venusaur-Mega Earth Power on Kingambit 42.5-93.7% (no OHKO, 2x). Kingambit Iron Head on Weavile 69-196% (KO at low HP); Sucker Punch on Weavile 14-43%; foe Venusaur Sludge Bomb on Weavile 25-74%. Weavile Icicle Crash on Venusaur 61-136.8% (not guaranteed KO at 65%, 90% acc); Ice Shard weaker. Venusaur-Mega durable: tanks Kingambit Iron Head 24-42%, foe Venusaur Sludge Bomb 21-39%; immune to Sleep Powder, resists Giga Drain; can Giga Drain-heal. Venusaur-Mega's moves on foe Venusaur weak (Sludge Bomb 0.5x, Earth Power 1x 21-47%, Giga Drain 0.25x) so Weavile is the Venusaur answer. Kingambit has Chople/Defiant/SuckerPunch; foe Venusaur WideLens Chlorophyll, Protect streak unreliable. Foe back: Tauros-Aqua (Intimidate/Sitrus), Dragonite (Multiscale/Yache/Tailwind) not brought this game.

reflections.summary: Lost because Incineroar outlasted the team’s remaining answers; once Mega Charizard Y and Kingambit were gone, Venusaur could not reliably finish or permanently contain it, and sun made Incineroar’s Flare Blitz more threatening. The four available Pokémon had to be brought, but the Charizard-Y Mega plan did not secure the necessary Incineroar matchup.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, prioritize preserving Mega Charizard Y and use its immediate Solar Beam pressure to remove or heavily weaken Incineroar before committing Venusaur to an endgame; do not rely on repeated Sleep Powder/Protect cycles as the sole Incineroar answer.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Game 2 revealed Jolly Focus Sash Pressure Weavile, Modest Thick Fat Mega Venusaur, Jolly Life Orb Poison Touch Sneasler, and Careful Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar. Kingambit Defiant can punish Intimidate, but Sucker Punch is vulnerable to Protect and sleep. Future plan: preserve Charizard Y and pressure Incineroar early with Solar Beam rather than leaving Venusaur to solo it.
